title: An instance's Properties match the variants mock
goal: The variants mock draws what you see when you pick a component instance: a Component row saying it is linked with a Detach button, the variant and size as segmented choices, and the instance's own toggles under Instance properties. Nobody has put the app beside that mock yet. Do it, and make the app match wherever it differs.
notes: ui-building success item 2 names ui-variants.html; no audit has ever compared against it (grep queue/audits for ui-variants: only passing mentions in 2026-10-04-one-instance-drop.json). Mock page docs/design/mocks/pages/ui-variants.html, rendered from the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8791/pages/ui-variants.html. Mock's Properties: header 'PROPERTIES · Instance', a 'Component' sub-header with 'linked' badge, a row 'Button >' with 'Detach', VARIANT segmented Primary | Secondary | Ghost, SIZE segmented Small | Medium | Large, 'Instance properties' sub-header with a diamond, 'Show icon' switch. Segmented controls are the app's own (see task every-segmented-control-is-apple-s-own-liquid-gl). The variant matrix on the canvas (every cell a real specimen) is a separate surface: compare it too, but if building it is more than polish, file it as a follow-up rather than growing this task. Placement contract: docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md top table; Properties rows only.
acceptance: A picture of the app with a Button instance picked sits beside ui-variants.html in the audit, in dark and light, and every difference in layout, control type, wording, spacing and colour is listed
Each difference is fixed in the app, or, where matching would undo something the user decided, written in rough with the decision it comes from
Picking Secondary or Large in the panel changes the instance on the canvas at once, and the Show icon toggle hides and shows its icon, in one undo step each
A walk photographing the picked instance runs green at Next defaults
Audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Adversarial pass 1 (before building), app vs ui-variants.html, picked Button instance photographed dark+light at Next defaults (/tmp/photonz-playtest/instance-props-before). App today: COMPONENT header; '◆ Button' plain line; sentence 'A copy. Editing the original changes this one too.'; 'Properties' sub-heading with Label field; bordered Edit Original + Make Unique buttons. Mock: header 'Component ◆ linked' (violet), a select-style field [◆ Button >] with a Detach text link beside it, VARIANT and SIZE as full-width segmented controls under small caps labels, 'Instance properties ◆' (violet) with Show icon switch (+On word), Label field, Icon swap dropdown, a long note, an 'In the API' code block, and a Reset props button. What the mock assumes that the app cannot deliver: (1) a component holds at most ONE variant property today (componentVariantProperties returns 0 or 1), so Variant AND Size cannot both exist; (2) the starter Button has one drawing, no icon, no Show icon/Icon properties, so there is nothing to put Secondary/Large/Show icon on. Both become prerequisite tasks; acceptance item 3 waits for them. Decided-by-user items that stay: 'Make Unique' not 'Detach' (card a-copy-of-a-component-is-configured-not-authored, answered 2026-09-20: 'you can right click and make unique'); the name row is the swap menu (2026-09-23 audit: user chose the row). First-time-user stop: nothing in the panel today says the instance is still linked except a sentence; the mock's 'linked' badge says it in one word. Building this run: linked badge in the header, mock-style component field (Edit Original on press, swap choices in its menu), Make Unique as a link beside it, sentence removed, variant as a segmented control under a small caps label, 'Instance properties' heading, Reset properties button, mock note behind the header question mark.

Built (Next, ComponentPanel.swift + InspectorPanel.swift + VideoKit SelectFace/Dropdown): Component header carries '◆ linked' in the component violet with a question mark holding the mock's note (UX-PATTERNS §4 move); the explanatory sentence under the name is gone; the main is a regular-height select face with the component mark and a right chevron (press = Edit Original; when other components exist it is a dropdown: Edit Original, divider, Swap To + components, current ticked and dimmed); Make Unique is a blue text link beside it (user's word for Detach); the variant row is a SegmentedControl (.fill) under a 9pt small caps label, falling back to a dropdown when words do not fit, Mixed lights nothing; knobs are headed 'Instance properties' in violet with the mark; Reset section with 'back to the main defaults' and a full-width Reset Props (new PhotonzCore resetInstanceProperties/canResetInstanceProperties, TDD: ComponentResetPropertiesTests, 5 tests; clears property overrides and puts the copy on the first variant, one undo step, skips locked copies; own size/type/look keep their own reverts).

Adversarial pass 2 (built thing, probe, unlocked screen, real captures): the field + link fit at panel width and truncate a long name; Reset Props sits dimmed most of the time and costs ~60pt, kept because the mock draws it; segmented chip reads grey in walk captures because walks keep the window in the back (system behaviour; black on that grey measured ~3.9:1, legible, not filed; same on the Library's Comps chip). Found and filed: dropping a tile into the original you are editing becomes part of it, including a copy of the same component (dropping-a-button-into-the-button-original-you-a, p2, reproduced). My first walk draft hit exactly that: it dropped tiles while the original's space was open; fixed with doneEditingOriginal. Walks updated for the variant row becoming segmented: component-whole-path-walk (expect menu Variant -> segment control), tool-and-library-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk (panelMenu Variant -> press the segment with the pointer); EveryDropdownIsClickedByAWalkTests builtSites 8 -> 7 and Variant removed from builtNames; the new Component dropdown is opened by pointer in instance-properties-variants-mock-walk. Walks green on the final build: instance-properties-variants-mock (7 real captures), all 24 '*component*' walks, 31 copy-/version-/starter- walks, button-states-journey, component-whole-path. Scripts/test.sh green, 11,927 tests.

Acceptance 3 split: picking a look in the panel changes the instance at once and undoes in one step (walk: Secondary pressed with the pointer, Cmd-Z back to Default, Reset Props back to Default). Large and Show icon need the app to have them first: a component can hold only one variant property, and the starter Button has no sizes or icon. Those are now a-component-can-have-a-variant-and-a-size-at-onc (p1, seq 100) and the-starter-button-comes-as-primary-secondary-or (p1, seq 101, depends on it), whose checklists carry exactly that check plus the mock's Label T glyph and Show icon On word. Left rough, not filed (below the bar): the Reset row is dimmed most of the time; the version labels in the original's space overlap ('Button · Default' over 'Secondary'), already the subject of the done version-labels task and only seen inside the edit space.

Shipped 3061dbe0 (Next): a picked instance's panel matches ui-variants.html where the app has the parts: linked badge (mock note behind its ?), main as a select face with mark + right chevron (Edit Original; swap menu when other components exist), Make Unique link, variant as a segmented control under a small caps label, Instance properties heading, Reset Props (new PhotonzCore resetInstanceProperties, TDD). Verified: instance-properties-variants-mock-walk green at Next defaults with 7 real captures in dark and light (Secondary pressed by pointer, Cmd-Z back in one step, Reset back to Default); 24 component walks + 31 copy/version/starter walks green; Scripts/test.sh green (11,927). Audit queue/audits/2026-10-09-instance-properties-variants-mock.json with side-by-side pictures; every mock difference names its settler. Size, Show icon and Icon need prerequisites now filed p1: a-component-can-have-a-variant-and-a-size-at-onc, the-starter-button-comes-as-primary-secondary-or (they carry acceptance 3's Large/Show icon check). Bug filed: dropping-a-button-into-the-button-original-you-a.

Its prerequisite landed in dbf55248: a component can ask Variant and Size at once, and a copy shows a VARIANT row and a SIZE row. Picking Secondary or Large now works once the starter Button has those looks (the-starter-button-comes-as-primary-secondary-or).
